events.title: One Big Beautiful Bill signed: ~$940B Medicaid cuts, but SNF rate cuts dropped and staffing mandate delayed 10 years
events.summary: The House passed the One Big Beautiful Bill on July 3, 2025 and President Trump signed it on July 4.
